note: All counts are from live prod D1 via scripts/wrangler-d1 (OAuth, D1-scoped). Replaces the prior error artifact from a compound-SELECT failure.

zz_test_fixture_projects.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE (slug LIKE 'zz-%' OR slug LIKE '_enum%' OR title LIKE 'zz-%' OR title LIKE '_ENUM%') AND deleted_at IS NULL
zz_test_fixture_projects.note: 32 zz-test projects were cleaned up in Phase 5. These 2 were created after the cleanup ran (new characterization-test batch). Awaiting soft-delete by Nick or mechanic.

task_status_enum_drift.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status NOT IN ('todo','in_progress','done','deleted','waiting','idea','someday','cancelled') AND deleted_at IS NULL
task_status_enum_drift.note: One task with status='blocked'. 'blocked' is not in the canonical enum domain. The validator will reject mutations that touch this task's status until it is corrected. Phase 5 cleanup normalized enum drift but did not cover this task (likely created after the cleanup ran).

project_stage_enum_drift.note: Projects table does not have a 'stage' column in D1 (confirmed: no such column error). The stage field lives only in brain.db (PB-only cache). No D1 stage enum drift possible.

orphan_tasks.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects p WHERE p.id = t.project_id) AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
orphan_tasks.note: All orphan tasks reference legacy slug-format project_ids (e.g. 'admin-tasks', not 'proj_{ulid}'). These predate the proj_{ulid} migration and are NOT a result of Phase 5 cleanup. Phase 5 cleanup only soft-deleted proj_{ulid}-format test fixtures. The slug→ulid re-linking is a separate pre-existing backlog item.

verdict: Phase 5 cleanup is substantially complete. Two zz-test residuals and one 'blocked'-status task remain; these were not present during the Phase 5 run (created after). The 599 orphan tasks are all pre-migration slug references, not Phase-5 regressions. Deploy is safe from zz-test contamination of real production data.
